instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: Not what's different between me and that person who earns a lot, but how are my past self and my later self different? In a way, the researchers stopped comparing people with others. Instead, they followed each person over time. It is like putting down binoculars you used to look at your neighbor's greener grass. Then you turn the pages of your own records. Then came diligence. This means taking things seriously and working hard. When a person's income went up, their diligence tended to rise later, too. This link was small. The link also went the other way. When diligence rose, income tended to rise later. That link was small, too. It was not a link in only one direction. It went both ways. But this is important, so let me say it clearly. The links were small. So, earning more makes me more serious? Wait, before you jump to that conclusion.
